title: Boy in Handmade Striped Playsuit Outdoors, 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: My first attempt at a little boy's suit didn't turn out too bad!
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of a young boy standing in a grassy yard beside a striped folding lawn chair. He wears a custom-sewn, striped two-piece or one-piece playsuit featuring a Peter Pan collar, short sleeves, a matching buckled belt, and front buttons, completed with dark socks and buckled sandals. The reverse side features a charming typewritten message by the maker proud of their sewing effort: 'My first attempt at a little boy's suit didn't turn out too bad!' reflecting Depression- or wartime-era domestic thrift, home sewing, and family life.
